text: Phase 2 and 3 plan: before observing outcomes, serialize the exact HalfFlow budget2x levels and controls plus matcher geometry, confidence, projector, assimilator, bridge-round limit, stopping rule, seeds, platform, and hardware. Keep basin-bridge-v1 unchanged; add a separate deterministic decomposition fixture with analytic images for 2/4/8/12 mm capture, rotation, affine background, regional residual, outliers, boundary loss, flat and repeated-pattern ambiguity, and identity. Run exactly three lanes: oracle to bridge; oracle to bridge to frozen HalfFlow; native block matcher to bridge to frozen HalfFlow. Record baseline and post-stage endpoint-error percentiles, confidence and cycle distributions, true-CC, support, accepted alpha and rounds, rejection reasons, determinant distribution and folds, export inverse error, runtime, allocations, memory, hashes, and full config. Emit a validator-backed receipt even when methods fail. Classify by the frozen table; define the normalized block-versus-oracle gap-closure threshold before the run, with 0.8 as the proposed retention threshold. Any follow-up changes only the implicated component and one factor at a time, then reruns every frozen lane.
